QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_12

question.text: Indus Valley AIF amended its PPM mid-year to clarify valuation methodology (non-material). The consolidated intimation of ALL PPM changes in a financial year must be sent to SEBI and investors within:

answer.text: 1 month of the end of the financial year, on a consolidated basis
6 months of year-end, along with the audited accounts

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI requires AIFs to intimate PPM and fund-document changes on a consolidated basis within one month of the end of each financial year, clearly identifying the changed clauses and revised page references. The Trap: 15 or 30 days per change confuses this annual consolidated filing with the separate event-based disclosure regime. A 6-month window waits for audited accounts and is not the prescribed timeline. Note: Material changes to fund documents may separately trigger exit rights for investors in close-ended funds; that is distinct from the annual consolidated intimation deadline.
